MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t01: Every campaign starts by defining exactly who you're targeting: industry, seniority, company size, and the buying signals that matter. The agent turns that into a structured search spec.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t02: Before anything runs, the pipeline checks it's within LinkedIn's API and usage limits, so it never pushes past what's safe.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t03: The automation searches LinkedIn against those ICP criteria and builds a live list of prospects who actually match.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t04: Matching profiles are pulled into a structured list: name, title, company, and profile URL for every prospect found.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t05: Every field is cleaned and standardised before it's checked against the ICP.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t06: A check runs on every prospect against the ICP criteria before anything else happens.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t07: Each prospect's profile, activity, company news, and mutual connections are read together and scored, so the outreach that follows is built around who they actually are, not a generic template.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t08: A personalized connection request note is generated for each individual prospect, based on their profile and the enrichment above, not copy-pasted across the list.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t09: Every send, every delay, every pause is run through this layer so sending behaviour mimics a real human, keeping the LinkedIn account safe from bans.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t10: The personalized note is sent as a connection request, on a schedule and pace set by the Human Behaviour Engine.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t11: A check runs on whether the connection was actually accepted before any follow-up goes out.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t12: The workflow waits and re-checks before deciding what happens next, never firing off the next step blindly.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t13: Follow-up messages go out in a timely manner, on the same human-safe schedule, so no warm prospect gets forgotten.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t14: A second, later follow-up for prospects who haven't replied yet, still on the same human-safe timing.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t15: Every request, reply, and acceptance is logged, so campaign and lifetime metrics stay accurate in real time.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t17: 2 · Enrichment, four parallel branches per prospect
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t24: Seven linked workflows: discover, enrich, score, connect, verify, follow up, converse. Every send passes through the Human Behaviour Engine. Google Sheets is the shared state between them.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t26: Homepage, about, pricing. Summarized to 3 lines.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t28: Last 5 posts, what they care about right now.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t30: Funding, hiring, launches in the last 90 days.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t31: TODO: delete the manual test branch before the client demo. Also the old v2 scorer is still here.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t32: Any failed send anywhere lands in #alerts within a minute.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t33: Each branch writes back to the lead row on its own. If one source is empty, the others still land.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t34: Threshold is tuned per client. Below 70 goes to archive, not the bin, and is re-scored monthly.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t35: Never more than 25 requests a day per seat, with 45 to 180 second gaps between sends.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t36: We wait for a real acceptance before any follow-up. Pending requests are re-checked every 6 hours, for up to 14 days.
MyntmoreFrameworkClient_s01.t37: Replies are drafted by the agent and approved by a human before anything goes back out.
